title: Chapter 436 Four Elephants Gathering
content:
Chapter 436 Four Elephants Gathering

What's more, this person's aura is the same as theirs, and they are all powerful people from their Heavenly Demon Clan.

In this way, they must be respectful.

Looking at the powerful people of the Heavenly Demon Clan in front of him, the old man sighed softly and said, "Eternal years have passed, and I don't know who can know me, Hao Yusheng now."

"It's you!"

The powerful man from the Heavenly Demon Clan who was closest to Hao Yusheng was shocked.

Suddenly, several Tian Yao tribes around him quickly saluted and said, "We have met Senior Hao."

Looking at the extremely respectful demons, Hao Yusheng frowned and said in surprise: "You actually recognize me, haha, it's really surprising."

However, the powerful man from the Tiande Clan who exclaimed hesitated and said, "Uh, I don't recognize him, I just think I should be surprised."

Seeing Hao Yusheng's face change slightly, he hurriedly said, "But these colleagues must recognize you."

Hearing his words, the monsters around him felt a little embarrassed.

"Well, I'm surprised by you. I think it would be a bit rude if I don't recognize you."

"What? So, you don't recognize it?"

"Don't recognize it?"

"What about you, do you recognize me?"

“Never heard of it.”

“…”

In the small secret room, the air was filled with an awkward atmosphere.

Hao Yusheng took a deep breath and then silently drilled back into the bracelet.

At this time, Bai Xu quickly stopped Hao Yusheng.

"Senior wait!"

Hao Yusheng paused his floating body and turned to look at Bai Xu.

Bai Xu's eyes were firm, and his eyes were filled with unconcealed excitement, "Senior, I have found a way to restore your body."

The next moment, Bai Xu spread his palms and a flawless white and irregular meat ball appeared in the secret room.

Looking at the white group in front of him, the tribe leaders of the Tiande Tribe suddenly widened their eyes and their eyes were filled with light.

Even Hao Yusheng was a little stunned.

He murmured unconsciously, "Supreme body."

Bai Xu chuckled, "Senior, there is nothing better to use to restore your body than this."

Hearing this, Hao Yusheng looked at Bai Xu and asked, "Where are you from?"

When Bai Xu entered the Tianjiao List and rushed to the list, Hao Yusheng lost his perception of the outside world in the bracelet, which was the suppression effect of the Tianjiao List.

So he didn't know that Bai Xu received the reward on the Tianjiao List.

Bai Xu whispered softly, saying, "This is the encouragement award I have given to me by hitting the top of the list, which can be used to help you recover your body."

The other powerful men from the Heavenly Demon Clan were silent and stared at Bai Xu in a daze.

Hao Yusheng said in a slight voice: "Child, do you know how much help it will be for you if you integrate the supreme body into your body, even if you lie down and sleep every day, you will naturally enter the supreme. territory."

"From then on, the Supreme Realm will be just a starting point for you. From now on, you will be at least the Holy Grade Heaven Supreme, or even the Heavenly Grade City,"

"So what?"

Bai Xu interrupted Hao Yusheng, "Senior has been recreating me. If I hadn't been to senior, maybe I wouldn't be able to top the list, I wouldn't be able to defeat Zhang Changfan, and I wouldn't be able to get this supreme body."

"I'm very glad that this is the encouragement he gave me. Otherwise, if you want to restore your body, you will probably have to search for it for a long time."

After Bai Xu finished speaking, the secret room fell into silence again.

Hao Yusheng just looked at Bai Xu like this. This was the first time he looked at Bai Xu so seriously.

After a long time, Hao Yusheng suddenly smiled and said, "I will introduce myself again. I am the founder of the Tian Demon Clan, Qilin and Sheng."

"The first four symbols of the Heavenly Demon are my disciples."

.........

In front of the gate of the deserted city.

Two figures stood quietly in front of the gate, staring at the legendary giant city in front of them.

"I never expected that I could enter the deserted city since my lifetime."

One of the young people smiled.

He has a handsome face, a slender figure, his long hair floats casually behind his head, and a rebellious smile hangs on the corner of his mouth.

Qinghai, the four symbols of the Qinglong.

The other one has a slightly thick body shape and a Chinese-shaped face. He looks a little anxious, but the childishness in his eyes cannot deceive others.

Xuansi, the four symbols Xuanwu.

"The deserted city is not only the deserted city of the human race, but also the deserted city of the world."

When Qinghai heard Xuan Si's words, he just smiled and said nothing more.

Such words are just saying.

If the deserted city is the deserted city in the world, how could it create a situation where there are many powerful people in the Chaos Realm today?

"Two guys stay."

Just as Qing Xuan and the others were about to enter the deserted city, an ethereal voice suddenly came from behind.

The two of them looked back at the same time and saw a colorful Vermilion Bird flying towards the place.

"Surf Bird!"

Qinghai said in surprise.

Soon, Zhuque came to the deserted city and changed into a human form.

"Miss Bai Ling, I have long admired my name."

Xuan Si stepped forward and greeted with a honest smile.

Qinghai also nodded slightly to Bai Ling.

This is the first time the three of them have met.

However, the three of them have a very familiar feeling about each other, as if they should have a good relationship.

"My name is Xuan Si, his name is Qinghai. We come to the Huangcheng City to challenge the genius list in the name of the clan leader."

"My name is Bai Ling. The patriarch has told me everything. If you challenge the genius list, Bai Ling is willing to go with you."

When Qinghai and Xuan Si heard Bai Ling's words, they both smiled.

But at this time, Bai Ling said again: "However, before this, Bai Ling will go to the city lord's mansion first."

"You two want to be with me, or,

"City Lord's Mansion?"

Qinghai was about to refuse, but Xuan Si's eyes lit up, "Okay, then thank you sister Bai Ling."

Seeing this, Bai Ling smiled slightly, then took Qinghai and Xuansi into the deserted city and headed straight to the city lord's mansion.

On the other side, in a secret room in the deserted city, several monsters looked carefully at the old man in front of him, not daring to breathe.

The ancestor of the Tiande Clan is their ancestor!

I never expected that this old man would be so terrifying.

Similarly, Bai Xu didn't expect it.

At this time, several demons were watching Hao Yusheng tinkering with the supreme body.

As time goes by, the Supreme Cat has begun to gradually exude vitality, just waiting for Hao and Sheng’s soul to return to their position.

"I felt the breath of the other three four symbols."

At this moment, Hao Yusheng suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, Bai Xu was slightly stunned and immediately said excitedly: "Sister is here in Huangcheng!"

"Senior, I,"

"Go, I'll go find you after I recover."

Bai Xu nodded heavily, and the powerful men of the Tiande Clan around him also said, "Young Master Bai Xu, just go there, our ancestors have us."

Seeing this, Bai Xu no longer hesitated and ran and jumped away from here.

"younger sister!!"

From afar, Bai Xu saw his sister Bai Ling and shouted excitedly.

When Bai Ling saw his brother, he also had tears in his eyes.

The two rushed in both directions.
